title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind — Episode4 An Unexpected Call

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Phew...
We sure did a lot today, looking at four different houses.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, and we found a really amazing house right at the end!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, there's no telling whether or not we're going to get approved.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll be meeting with the landlady at eight the evening after next for an interview, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to be interviewed. I'm actually a little nervous. What do you think we're going to be asked...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Questions that show whether or not we're actually capable of making our dreams come true, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How are we supposed to clearly convey that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Whatever you're asked, I think you should tell this landlady how you truly feel. Just be yourselves and say whatever comes to mind.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is someone calling?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Saito.
Let me just press the speakerphone button and... Yes, hello?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Hello!
You all went to look at those houses, yes? Did you find anything nice?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we found a very lovely one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We have to get approved for it first... But you've really gotta see it, Saito!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<That's great to hear...!
I really wish I could be there with you all, but the inn's just too busy right now...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's more than okay.
We still can't thank you enough for finding a real estate agency for us while working at your family's inn.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If we do manage to get approved, you're gonna be the first one to receive a tour! So wish us luck!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Thank you!
I feel even more motivated to do a good job here!>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Oh, also...
There's another reason why I called you.>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <The producer for iHaz, Mr. Kuromiya, just contacted me.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Yes, and...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Apparently, the idol group that was supposed to appear on one of his other shows had to cancel all of a sudden...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <So, MORE MORE JUMP! is being asked to fill in for them.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait...
We get to be on TV again?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Yes, but it's a tight schedule.
The shoot for it is the day after tomorrow... How do you all feel about this?>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <You currently have nothing going on that day, but I felt that I should ask just in case.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The day after tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's when the landlady's going to interview us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As important as that interview is, we shouldn't let a chance like this slip by...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. And since it's one of Mr. Kuromiya's shows, it's probably going to air for one of the big networks... This is a huge opportunity for us to raise our name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-By the way, did you hear when it might end?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Let's see... It's scheduled to end at three.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that works out really well since our interview is at eight.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we'd have five hours to pack up and move! That should be more than enough time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, would you mind accepting this offer on our behalf?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Understood!
Also, are you all free after this?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we're free.
We were actually just about to head home...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Perfect!
The thing is, the station would like to have a meeting with you right now if possible.>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <They don't seem set on it if it's too much trouble, but would you be willing to make a quick detour...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If the shoot's the day after tomorrow, we should sit down and meet with them as soon as we can.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Wonderful!
Then, I'll let the station know that you'll be dropping by soon. In the meantime, please start heading over.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Roger!
Thank you so much, Saito!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That's awesome.
You really get to be on TV again?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know, right?
We really can't thank Mr. Kuromiya enough. First, we got to go on iHaz, and now this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<But you all should hurry.
I'm sure the producer's eagerly awaiting your arrival.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Then, we should head back to SEKAI.
Tell us how things go later, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
We'll talk again soon!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Alright, we should get going.
See you all later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Bye bye!>
Several dozen minutes later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I thought it was pretty close by...
But getting here took longer than I was expecting! I hope we're not making Mr. Kuromiya wait on us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, none of us knew they were doing all that road construction...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, we gotta hurry!
We just got a message saying that he'll be waiting for us at seven in the meeting room.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Seven...? Wait, that's in five minutes!
Once the light turns green, we should bolt and...
Ah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Oh, pardon me...
This is so embarrassing. I think I just broke a heel...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Can you stand?
Here, take my hand.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You're so sweet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...!
Is your foot hurt? Maybe your ankle?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe so...
I may've twisted it a little just now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We should find a place where you can rest. Are there any benches or...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
No, no, I'll be fine.
I appreciate the concern, but I should be able to make it to my destination. It's actually just right there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I'll help you get there!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You guys go on ahead without me, okay?
I'll be right behind you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay.
We'll let Mr. Kuromiya know that you're helping her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
See you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
You and your friends also seemed to be in a hurry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's totally okay since they agreed to go on ahead without me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, where were you headed?
My hope is that you'll get a chance to rest there and...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, actually, it's right there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Where...?
Wait, the TV station?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm here to see the shoot for a talk show.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: But it'll be starting soon. Whatever shall I do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's going to be a part of the studio audience...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But they probably won't let her in once the cameras start rolling. She seems so excited about it. I don't want her to miss out...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please let me carry you on my back!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be able to move faster, and you might just make it in time to see that shoot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You sounded really excited about it, so I don't want you to miss it!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori...
I really appreciate you being so kind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Again, it's okay!
We were also just headed there anyway!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, please hang on tight...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wait a second...
When did I tell her my name?)
